checks: all 262 forms in exact input order
261 exact original-default IPA matches; underground selects existing source UK noun IPA by explicit authorization
full spelling and complete pair/chunk selected-IPA reconstruction
stress counts and marked-vowel placement match the selected IPA
full original UK/US IPA strings preserved; learner pronunciation notes cleaned to literal IPA facts
mixed lexical headword UK fields restricted to the matching form
p.m., t-shirt, x-ray punctuation and letter names

validation.scope: Offline validation against supplied pronunciation material. No claim of independent live source recheck or teacher audition.

generation.modelEntry: Actual local Claude Code CLI --model coder; routing memory read before invoking CLI. Only returned model aliases are reported here.
generation.recovery: All 262 alignments were reconstructed by Codex against the exact input IPA. The 20 words missing from returned drafts received a subsequent actual Coder constrained review of the reconstructed maps. Raw drafts were preserved, never loaded as application content.

warnings.research: Rejected the warning: compact mapping already has stress=1 on re; supplied IPA is /ˈriːsɝːtʃ/. Its claim that stress is reversed contradicts the actual row.
warnings.respect: Rejected the warning: spect contains /e/ in supplied /rɪˈspekt/; e is sounded, and the row already marks the second vowel primary.
warnings.responsible: Rejected the warning: supplied /rɪˈspɑːnsəbəl/ begins /rɪ/ and the row already marks spon primary. The proposed first-vowel replacement conflicts with the input.
warnings.restaurant: Rejected the warning: exact supplied /ˈres.tə.rɑːnt/ uses /e/ and primary stress on res. It must not be silently changed to /eɪ/ or /ɛ/.

missingWordCoderReview.adjudication: Sixteen OK responses and four warnings. The four warnings conflict with the exact input IPA or existing stress labels and were rejected by Codex after inspection.

originalDraftExamples.problem: Draft maps c to /ks/ and omits final s; final map separates c=/k/, s=/s/.
Draft invents h in the spelling and assigns c=/t/; final keeps c=/k/, t=/tʃ/, ure=/ər/.
Draft replaces supplied t̬ with d; final preserves t̬ exactly.
Draft omits punctuation and primary stress; final retains p. and m. as letter names with exact stress.
Draft puts stress on consonants and spells out an unsupported tion pronunciation; final marks la vowel primary and tion=/ʃən/.
Draft repeats letters and chunks; final reconstructs window exactly once.

boundaries: Codex content review, not teacher-certified phonetic review.

Source URLs and original UK/US IPA strings come from existing reviewed pronunciation material. Learner prose was cleaned to remove Chinese sound approximations and internal workflow language; no fresh dictionary lookup is claimed.
Chunk boundaries support spelling-to-sound alignment and do not claim strict phonological syllable boundaries. Contiguous groups may correspond to several sounds.
Final integration selects source-existing UK noun underground /ˈʌndəɡraʊnd/ to match the recording; the previous US adjective/adverb default and all source variants remain labelled in variantNote.
